name: open-envelope
title: Open envelope
description: A complete "your mail is full" state in isometric ink, facing the screen: an open envelope so stuffed that a document is pushed out of its pocket, a second sheet behind it, and an alert badge that pops at its corner, over a heading, a line of copy and two buttons you set through props. One even outline, no shadow; the badge carries your brand. Click to replay; leans with the pointer; in your theme.

useCases: Inbox full and storage limit screens in mail apps
Quota reached and upgrade prompts in SaaS products
File storage and attachment limit warnings
Empty and overflow states for messaging tools
